resources.string: No internet — choose the time manually
Couldn\'t recognize the note — choose the time manually
Couldn\'t tell when to remind you in the recording
Heard: “%1$s” — but couldn\'t tell when to remind

A recording\'s sound — or, when you speak to the mic button, the recognized text — is sent to Google Gemini only to find out what and when to remind. Nothing else leaves your phone. You can turn this off in settings.
Say “tomorrow at 9…” — the reminder is set automatically. The recording\'s sound or the spoken text is sent to Google Gemini.
